record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: Are any of the τ-cover selection properties S1(Ω, T), Sfin(Ω, T), S1(T, Γ), S1(T, T), S1(T, Ω), Sfin(T, T), or Sfin(T, Ω) preserved under finite powers?

evidence.quote: Are any of the properties (1) S1(Ω, T), or Sfin(Ω, T), (2) S1(T, Γ), S1(T, T), S1(T, Ω), Sfin(T, T), or Sfin(T, Ω), preserved under taking finite powers?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be an infinite topological space. A cover U of X by proper open subsets is called:
- an ω-cover (notation Ω) if every finite subset of X is contained in some member of U;
- a γ-cover (notation Γ) if U is infinite and every x ∈ X belongs to all but finitely many members of U;
- a τ-cover (notation T) if U is a large cover (each x ∈ X is in infinitely many members of U) and for any two points x, y ∈ X, either {U ∈ U : x ∈ U, y ∉ U} or {U ∈ U : y ∈ U, x ∉ U} is finite.

For classes A, B of covers of X, define the selection principles:
- S1(A, B): for every sequence (Un)n∈N of covers from A there exist Un ∈ Un such that {Un : n ∈ N} ∈ B.
- Sfin(A, B): for every sequence (Un)n∈N of covers from A there exist finite Fn ⊆ Un such that ⋃n Fn ∈ B.

A property P of topological spaces is said to be preserved under finite powers if whenever X satisfies P, then Xk satisfies P for every positive integer k.

Question: Determine, for each of the selection properties
   S1(Ω, T), Sfin(Ω, T), S1(T, Γ), S1(T, T), S1(T, Ω), Sfin(T, T), Sfin(T, Ω),
whether it is preserved under finite powers.
artifact.status_search_result: Surveys of open problems on selection principles (including the milestone of open problems survey and subsequent papers on the combinatorics of τ-covers by Tsaban and collaborators) list the preservation of these τ-cover selection properties under finite powers as open. While progress has been made on related cardinal characteristics and on some τ-cover problems, no resolution of the finite-power preservation question for these seven principles has been reported.

status_evidence.title: The combinatorics of tau-covers
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates τ-cover selection hypotheses; some problems solved, others remain open.
status_evidence.claim: τ-cover preservation questions remain partially unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Selection Principles and special sets of reals: Open problems

status_evidence.claim: Problem is explicitly posed as open.
